chapter: On the road with Duke and his bandmates
title: Travelling by Pullman and band bus
summary: On one-nighters they used two Pullmans and a baggage car, or the band bus, staying on the Pullmans in the South.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: When you first started out on the road with Duke, that was what? After you played the Cotton Club and the band went out on the road on one nighters?
That was when the band traveled in trains?

Either way; either busses or trains. Most of the time we had to use two Pullmans and a baggage car, because we park on the station when we play the dance, and when we get through, come back there and go back to what's her name and wait until the engine comes to take us wherever we were going the next night.
When you weren't on the train -- what, you had a band bus?
When you didn't have the train, you were on the bus, a band bus?
Oh, certainly. We had a bus of our own.
And what about places to stay? Could the band go to hotels?
Yeah. Only, down South, naturally, that's when we had the Pullmans.
